text: Entry 682 updates the owned Matrix README from babel.config.js to babel.config.cjs and replaces proposal plugin names with transform plugin names. Current instructions still name babel.config.cjs and show module.exports with the transform plugins. The nearby Custom .babelrc heading remains older wording, so it must not be treated as another required filename. Manual documentation and filename proposal for this update flow: use the configuration filename and plugin names that the checked source actually uses in steps and examples, and reconcile stale headings. Do not rename ordinary Thunderbird JavaScript files to .cjs from this one build configuration.
title: Use the actual Matrix build configuration filename in update instructions
